name: Disposable Raincoat Ball
description: The disposable foldable raincoat is packed in a plastic key chain,it is light and beautiful, and the ball shape is very creative. It is easy to carry. There are hooks on the ball, which can be hung in the bag or anywhere. The raincoat can be folded into a very small size and stored in the ball, which can be put in the backpack or hung on the backpack, which is convenient to carry and respond to sudden rainy days.This emergency raincoats are suitable for hiking, cycling, outdoor activities or going out on rainy days, etc. A foldable outdoor must-have for your travels and a great gift for friends, family and colleagues.
summary: The raincoat ball packed with the portable disposable raincoat light in weight and easy-to-use hanging.
